description:
PATH TO THE STARS

We are a group of students looking for a meaningful challenge, we trully believe that the biggest project starts with the smallest idea. United by our desire to learn, grow, and try new things, we want to use this experience as a way for us to be better while working together to impact lifes with out project.

We embrace change and are always open to feedback, learning from the best is why we are here!!. Let's learn together! :PPPP
